benchVsRecordedGeometry: agent preset: bench arms run the official rc.7 `standard` (arc, via bridge) and a byte-identical clone `basic-early` (basic) — the recorded arms ran the legacy router-standard family presets (different system prompts and tool surface)

code-suite provider: opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash with a 384000 adapter-default maxTokens (settings.yaml) — the recorded arms ran deepseek-official with a 256000 adapter default; both are adapter-filled defaults (no caller intent), but the reserve number differs

session-shape variance is model-driven: same fixture bytes and prompts, but flash chose leaner/denser tool paths under the current preset, changing call counts, compaction placements, and summarizer cache luck
per-arm anomalies are recorded in each bench report (turnErrors, settleOk flags, compaction provider metadata)

turnErrors.note: scnet transport blip mid-run; stage-3 minutes text landed on the surface before the error, so the treatment (compaction of the minutes) was unaffected; the arm still scored 12/12 + 10/10

codePairFlipAnalysis: quality: the direction and the ARC ceiling reproduced exactly (24/24 + 4/4, project tests 4/4); Basic collapsed again (12/24 + 0/4) but retained 6 more proofs than the recorded 6/24 - outside the 1-fact noise band

cost: the flip is dominated by session-shape variance, not by the treatment. The recorded Basic paid 76,070 uncached tokens for TWO summarizer calls (36,093 + 39,977 inputTokens); this Basic fired ONE summarizer call that hit the provider prefix cache almost fully (499 uncached + 53,760 cache-read), i.e. summarizer luck moved ~75K uncached between arms

the recorded ARC arm spent 121,146 uncached over a 2-local-block session; this ARC arm spent 174,021 over a 3-compaction session that included one model-written compress (19,655-char summary) plus arc_status - more tool turns (21 vs 15 model calls) churn the prefix more under the same window patch

the recorded pairs ran the legacy router-standard preset family and deepseek-official (256K adapter default); the bench arms run the rc.7 standard preset and opencode-go (384K adapter default) - both defaults are adapter-filled (no caller intent), but the preset system prompt and tool surface differ, which changes flash's tool-loop economy

conclusion: the recorded code-pair cost conclusion (Governor wins quality AND all three token fields on this fixture) does not transfer to the current host geometry at single-seed scale; the quality conclusion does. RQ1 stays open per the commission rule - no threshold loosening

rq1Closure.note: within-noise definition per the commission: quality within 1 fact of each recorded value, cost delta direction-consistent and within ±10pp of the recorded amplitude

budget.note: global commission budget <=150 model calls; 10 were spent by task C, 45 by the four task-B arms (21 + 4 + 15 + 5), 55 total - well within
